title: tron.check_report.v1
description: Canonical record of a single pre-trade check evaluation (PID section 12/13). Contract-owner: WI-B (WO-TRON-D1). This contract defines the record shape only; the check catalogue, stage numbering meaning and individual check IDs are owned by WI-C (06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md, checks.schema.json).

contract_version.description: Canonical contract major version. Must equal "1" for tron.check_report.v1.

check_id.description: Stable check identifier, matching an entry in the WI-C check catalogue (06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md).

stage.description: Ordered pre-trade check stage this check belongs to, per PID section 12 (0 = operational safety/kill state, ... 6 = projected post-trade state).

result.description: Outcome of this check. ERROR is not equivalent to PASS (PID section 12); where an ERROR creates execution uncertainty, TRON fails closed for new risk (HR-14).

observed_evidence.description: Structured evidence actually observed while evaluating this check (e.g. the specific balances, positions or state values inspected). Deliberately an open map: evidence shape varies per check_id and is not constrained by this envelope contract. Always present; an empty object means no additional evidence beyond the result itself was captured.

configured_parameters.description: Configuration parameter values this check was evaluated against (e.g. a configured limit or threshold). Deliberately an open map for the same reason as observed_evidence. Always present; an empty object means this check takes no configured parameters.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the result. Required when result == "FAIL" (a failed check must explain why it failed, PID section 9.5). Optional for PASS and ERROR: absent for PASS means no explanation was needed; absent for ERROR means the error detail is being carried elsewhere (e.g. the durable event/journal record) rather than duplicated here.

timestamp.description: UTC epoch-ms at which this check was evaluated.
